subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should OpenClaw make persistent browser-origin pairing and run-scoped plugin `toolBindings` permanent shared contracts for the bundled per-tab copilot, rather than keeping the capability confined to a narrower browser-owned seam?
rationale: The branch is a plausible security-oriented implementation, but it adds durable device-pairing data and a generic plugin context field whose long-term ownership and compatibility commitment cannot be chosen mechanically.

options.title: Approve the shared contracts
options.body: Accept the additive pairing fields and generic tool-binding context after browser, gateway, plugin, and dependency review confirms their documented compatibility boundary.

options.title: Narrow the core surface
options.body: Keep per-tab custody in the browser extension and expose only the minimum generic gateway or plugin seam needed for enforcement.

options.title: Stage the product direction
options.body: Pause this integration until the relationship with the existing side-panel implementation is explicitly consolidated into one supported rollout path.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contracts
recommendation.body: Accept the additive pairing fields and generic tool-binding context after browser, gateway, plugin, and dependency review confirms their documented compatibility boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The related browser side-panel proposal is the cited source of product direction for this workflow.
